articles.title: Horoscope for Tuesday, July 28, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

Caution! Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions until 9:15 p.m. After that, the moon moves from Capricorn into Aquarius.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

A positive day

Tread carefully because it's a moon alert for most of this day. Channel your energies into creative activities because today favors the arts, fun socializing and playful times with kids.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

Steer clear of controversial topics, as this is a poor day for important decisions since most of this day is a moon alert. Focus on home and family. Relax at home among familiar surroundings if you can do so.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

Get some physical energy today to blow off any pent-up steam that might be building up within you. Pay attention to everything you say and do today to avoid accidents. Relax and entertain at home.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

An average day

You have a strong need to share your ideas today. This could relate to something financial because you are focused right now on earnings, cash flow and personal wealth. (Because you can get richer this year!)

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A positive day

Enjoy physical, competitive sports and activities with friends and groups today. Be careful because you might want to shop for beautiful things as well — clothing, art objects and jewelry — which is a poor idea. Do not do this during the moon alert. (See above.)

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

A positive day

Although this is an excellent time for you to shop for wardrobe goodies — not today. Most of this day is a moon alert. Nevertheless, your ambition is strong. You're going to go after what you want! A discussion with someone younger could be beneficial.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

An average day

This is a popular time for you, and today is a wonderful day to schmooze with others. Because there is a moon alert for most of this day, it's a poor day for important decisions and shopping. However, it's a great day to relax and enjoy the company of friends.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

A positive day

It's important to know you make an excellent impression on others at this time, which is why this is a good week to go after what you want in terms of personal appearances, interviews, and asking authority figures for permission or approval. However, today is not the day. See moon alert above.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

An average day

Avoid financial decisions today and definitely avoid shopping for anything other than food and gas because most of this day is a moon alert. However, relations with authority figures are excellent. On the other hand, be patient with partners, spouses and close friends.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

A positive day

This is a tricky day because the moon is in your sign, which gives you a slight advantage. Nevertheless, it's a moon alert for most of this day. You have the energy to work, but be careful — agree to nothing important. Don't volunteer for anything. Restrict spending to food and gas.

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

An average day

Today you want to play. However, you might feel tension building up within you because tomorrow the full moon will be in your sign. This tension will likely arise between you and spouses, partners and close friends. Explore the arts and creative activities.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A positive day

This is the perfect day to hang out with friends and take things easy. If you choose to work hard, stick with a situation that requires few decisions. Most of this day is a moon alert, which is a poor time for new directions and new ideas. Restrict spending to food and gas.

If today is your birthday

Former first lady Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis (1929-1994) shares your birthday today. You're competitive and driven. You're charming, multitalented and full of intellectual energy. This is the final year of a nine-year cycle. Let go of the people, places and things from the past that held you back. Do some internal and external housecleaning. Focus on being compassionate and loving.

articles.title: 'Unprecedented but unsurprising': Climate change & lack of prevention behind wildfires, extreme heat
articles.description: Eve Irvine is pleased to welcome Alexander Held, Senior Expert of the Resilience Programme for Integrated Fire Management. He reframes Europe's wildfire crisis by arguing that the flames themselves are not the central problem but rather ecological and governance failures. Held asserts that fires are not unforeseeable natural disasters, there have been decades of scientific warnings about the devastating effects of climate change. He ultimately presents the wildfire crisis not only as an opportunity to fundamentally rethink our relationship with forests and landscapes.
